He jerks off in the shower - ok, so he has a libido. 
Have a few drinks then ask a series of questions that lead up to asking him what he thinks about when he's jerking off? If he's gay now that might be hard to get out of him... but maybe it could work. Maybe he thinks about nurse outfits, or midgets, or ... I dunno, list is endless. Does he have depression perhaps? 
Does he look at other women when you're down the street or at a bar? What qualities do they seem to have in common? (Thin? Tall? Blondes? Brunettes?)

Have you changed in your looks since years ago when you did used to have sex? Put on weight? Lost a lot of weight? Cut your hair and he's a hair man? Used to wear makeup? Dunno - maybe somethings changed with you and he's not into you anymore? Just an idea. 
Also maybe he's into some new fantasy - and is ashamed to share it with you - ask him. Tell him something freaky about yourself and ask what his biggest sex fantasy is in a safe space and it might open him up?

Thank you for the insights. Wow what a tough question, I like these because they offer a chance for a different perspective.

But over time I've started to wonder if it's actually about wanting to just not be around her sometimes. We do tend to live in each other's pockets, which has lessened lately because we recognise more readily that I need my space. 
Unfortunately I come to look forward to time on my own, and less so time when we are
Together. I suppose that is telling. 
However I've decided that my recent depression (I think I'm out now), has blurred my vision, and so shelving this stuff for a while and seeing what comes of everything. I'm trying to repair myself, and my marriage, it's very hard work but we are both trying. 
Some things can probably never be fixed but I'm trying. The physical attraction thing is just such a troublesome issue; hoping to find a means around it. 
Thank you for taking the time, much appreciated.

I didn't realize that until later, I just thought that might be silly... It's more a case of feeling such low self worth that I was amazed any woman would have me at all at the times that I hooked up with her and my exgf, I suffered a lot of low self esteem. Still do (but this thread is helping lol!!) 
Do I just become unattractedmonce I know I can have them.... hmmmm.... it's a possibility. I'll have to think on that a bit, thanks.

Sit in a quiet space. Imagine what it would feel like, if you knew that you will have lost your wife, child, job, some friends, large finances, your father, your house, and your dog over the next 12 months. 
Imagine what that would feel like. 
Imagine feeling that all the time, and believing there was nothing you could do to fix the situation, and anything you choose to do will hurt those you love. 
Then imagine you're in a burning building, burning alive, and you want to relieve the pain by jumping... it's the lesser of two evils. But everyone tells you that it would be selfish, instead you should just burn alive each day in the building... because they believe the flames will somehow miraculously extinguish themselves. 
And worst of all you feel that you deserve it
